standard_prerequisites.use: The equivalence of big etale sites of a thickening (Theorem topological-invariance of the same chapter, collected as S3-spaces-topological-invariance L1411) and the criterion that an etale universally injective morphism is an open immersion (Morphisms of Spaces); cited inputs with the construction written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Transport U -> X along the inverse of the etale-sites equivalence to an object U' -> X'.
Verify U' -> X' is etale and universally injective.
Conclude U' -> X' is an open immersion with U = X x_{X'} U'.

proof_roadmap.step: Lift U through the topological invariance equivalence of big etale sites.
Identify the lift as an open immersion via the etale universally injective criterion.

difficulty_reason: For a thickening X subset X' of algebraic spaces over S, every open subspace U of X is the base change of a unique open subspace U' of X'. The retained proof constructs U' as the object of the big etale site of X' corresponding to U under the topological invariance equivalence, observes that the resulting U' -> X' is etale and universally injective, and concludes it is an open immersion by the etale-plus-universally-injective characterization in Morphisms of Spaces. Retained author proof at lines 1656-1663.
